question: What is a small lie that completely spiraled out of control?
story: I told one tiny lie about speaking French, and it ended with me translating for my company's biggest client. During my interview, I said I knew a little French to sound impressive. I knew maybe five words, most of them foods. I got the job and completely forgot about it. Then eight months later, my boss burst into my cubicle glowing. A major client was flying in from Paris, and I was apparently our secret weapon. I panicked and spent every night for two weeks learning French like my life depended on it. The big meeting came. I sweated through my shirt, smiled, and threw out the few phrases I had crammed. The client laughed, switched to perfect English, and admitted he only wanted to test if I was honest about my resume. He signed the deal anyway. He said he respected the hustle. I now actually speak French.
